title: Codex adapter for write roles in the engine (#100)
lead: Owner decision #100 (supersedes #54): codex may run write roles. The engine has only the claude adapter (internal/agent/claude). Add internal/agent/codex: codex exec --json -s workspace-write with model and effort from the matrix row, JSONL parsing (thread, item and turn events), usage, the rate-limit strings in vendor.codex-ratelimit, and session resume. Update docs/design.md lines about codex read-only and the capability table. Depends on the sandbox spike slice.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- A fake codex run produces the same role result shape as the claude adapter.
- A write role runs with -s workspace-write; a read-only role with -s read-only.
- A rate-limit string classifies as rate-limited; an error classifies as error.
- design.md states codex may write per #100.
